# ruststream-kinesis

> `ruststream-kinesis` is the Amazon Kinesis Data Streams broker crate for RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. It runs over the official `aws-sdk-kinesis` client: a subscription discovers the stream's shards across splits and merges, leases each shard with fencing and checkpoints its progress, so an acknowledgement is a checkpoint and delivery is at-least-once.

A subscription is the descriptor `KinesisStream`, which names the stream by its name and carries the pause between reads; a bare `#[subscriber("orders")]` builds the same descriptor with its defaults. A service imports `ruststream_kinesis::prelude::*`, which offers `KinesisPublish` as `Publish`; the partition key of one publish is its per-message setting. The `dynamodb-lease` feature adds `DynamoLeaseStore`, so several service instances share the shards.

This site holds the guides, one page per component and the architecture of the crate; the API reference is on docs.rs, and the framework itself is documented on the RustStream site.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/): building a Kinesis service with the crate, from installation to production
- [Getting started](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/getting-started/): installation, a local Kinesis, a first subscriber against it and its test without a server
- [Consuming a stream](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/consuming/): one record or one batch at a time, the shard's read budget, and what a delivery carries
- [Shards, partition keys and ordering](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/ordering/): the shard of each record, per-key order under parallel handlers and across splits and merges
- [Checkpoints and delivery guarantees](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/checkpoints/): what each handler outcome does to a shard's checkpoint, and what a restart reads again
- [Retries and dead-letter streams](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/retries/): a retry now or later, the attempt cap, the dead-letter stream, and what a copy does to order
- [Replay and seeking](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/replay/): reading a stream again from its oldest record or from a moment, and seeking from inside a handler
- [Several instances](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/leases/): a DynamoDB lease table that gives each shard to one instance and keeps its checkpoint
- [Testing a Kinesis service](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/testing/): `TestApp` on the production app with keyed records, replies and delays, and the same test against a local stack
- [Running in production](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/guides/production/): credentials and region, streams owned by infrastructure, and IAM permissions

## Components

- [Components](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/): the parts of the crate a Kinesis service uses, one page each
- [KinesisBroker](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/broker/): the broker type and its lazy connection
- [Credentials](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/broker/credentials/): the AWS default chain at connect, and `from_config` for a config built elsewhere
- [Endpoint](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/broker/endpoint/): `endpoint`, `region` and `test_credentials` for a local stack such as LocalStack
- [Startup](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/broker/startup/): a subscription opens once every shard it took reads, and a missing stream stops the start
- [Shutdown](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/broker/shutdown/): `KinesisError::NotConnected` for a publisher or a seek handle used afterwards
- [Prelude](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/broker/prelude/): `ruststream_kinesis::prelude`, the one glob a Kinesis service imports
- [Errors](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/broker/errors/): `KinesisError`, the one error type of the crate
- [Subscriptions](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/subscriptions/): a stream name in `#[subscriber]` and the descriptor that carries every other setting
- [KinesisStream](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/subscriptions/kinesis-stream/): one stream, with its read pause and the shards it provisions when the stream is missing
- [poll_interval](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/subscriptions/poll-interval/): the pause between reads of an idle shard, against five reads a second per shard
- [create_if_missing](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/subscriptions/create-if-missing/): a missing stream created with the shard count it names
- [KinesisSubscriberExt](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/subscriptions/subscriber-ext/): `poll_interval` and `create_if_missing` on the mount chain
- [Shards](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/subscriptions/shards/): a lease and a reader per shard, and a split's children after their parents
- [Batches](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/subscriptions/batches/): slice handlers, with `batch(n)` as the `GetRecords` limit
- [Checkpoint](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/settlement/): an ack as a per-shard checkpoint, a drop, and a requeue a shard cannot perform
- [retry_after](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/settlement/retry-after/): a copy of the record published back to its stream once the delay is over
- [out_retry](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/settlement/out-retry/): the publisher the retry copies leave through; a copy keeps the record's partition key
- [Dead letters](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/settlement/dead-letters/): `max_attempts` and `dead_letter`, the stream a spent record goes to
- [LeaseStore](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/leases/): each shard's owner and checkpoint, and `SHARD_END` for a finished shard
- [MemoryLeaseStore](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/leases/memory-lease-store/): the default store, for one instance, empty again after a restart
- [DynamoLeaseStore](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/leases/dynamo-lease-store/): a DynamoDB table several instances share, behind the `dynamodb-lease` feature
- [LeaseKey](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/leases/lease-key/): one shard of one stream, and its `stream:shard` form
- [owner_id](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/leases/owner-id/): the name an instance holds its leases under
- [legacy_stream](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/leases/legacy-stream/): a lease table an earlier version wrote, read for one named stream
- [KinesisContext](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/context/): a record's position and the seek handle, through `Ctx<Position>` and `Ctx<SeekHandle>`
- [KinesisBatchContext](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/context/batch-context/): a batch handler's context and its seek handle
- [Headers](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/context/headers/): the sequence number, the shard and the partition key on every delivery
- [Envelope](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/context/envelope/): user headers in front of the payload, only when there are any
- [KinesisPosition](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/positions/): the trim horizon, the tip, an arrival timestamp, or one record of one shard
- [start_at](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/positions/start-at/): a subscription opened at a position on every startup
- [Seek](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/positions/seek/): a running subscription moved from its handler through `Ctx<SeekHandle>`
- [KinesisPublish](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/publishing/): the publish policy, `Publish` in the prelude, one `PutRecord` per record
- [Keys](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/publishing/keys/): the four places that name a record's partition key, and the order they resolve in
- [partition_key](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/publishing/partition-key/): the partition key of one record as a step on the publish builder
- [KinesisPublishSettings](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/publishing/publish-settings/): `partition_key` at the mount site, for every record of a position, a reply included
- [Kinesis bindings](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/asyncapi/): the Kinesis bindings of the AsyncAPI document behind the `asyncapi` feature
- [Server](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/asyncapi/server/): the endpoint's host and port or the regional host, never a credential
- [Channels](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/asyncapi/channels/): the stream, the read pause and the provisioned shards of each channel
- [Messages](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/asyncapi/messages/): a policy's partition key on the message object
- [Testing](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/testing/): `TestApp::start` with `KinesisBroker` in process behind the `testing` feature
- [Live](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/components/testing/live/): `TestApp::start_live`, the same test body against LocalStack or AWS

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/): how Kinesis Data Streams works, where the crate sits between Kinesis and the RustStream runtime, and what that costs
- [Streams](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/kinesis/): a stream as a set of shards, each an ordered log every consumer reads for itself
- [Shards and resharding](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/kinesis/shards/): a shard's share of throughput, and the children a split or a merge opens
- [Reading](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/kinesis/reading/): shard iterators, `GetShardIterator` and `GetRecords`
- [Leases](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/kinesis/leases/): a lease table with one row per shard, its owner, its expiry and its checkpoint
- [Design](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/design/): a reader per shard and a lease store between the runtime and the AWS SDK, one SDK client per runtime
- [Lifecycle](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/lifecycle/): `new`, `connect`, the shards each subscription opens, and shutdown
- [Path](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/path/): one record from the read through the handler and the reply to its checkpoint
- [Lanes](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/lanes/): a reader per shard into one channel, and `workers(n, by_key)` lanes keyed by partition key
- [Settlement](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/settlement/): what `ack`, drop, retry and `retry_after` become on a log with one checkpoint per shard
- [Benchmarks](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/benchmarks/): what the crate and the framework's runtime cost over the raw `aws-sdk-kinesis` client, and the cost of the crate's own code
- [Benchmarks: Numbers](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/benchmarks/numbers/): what each published number measures, and what it does not allow you to conclude
- [Benchmarks: Methodology](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-kinesis/latest/architecture/benchmarks/methodology/): the three loops, the run on a Kinesis endpoint and the code count
